## 📋 Checklist

**Before Starting:**
- [ ] Read [ETHIK_MANIFEST.md](../../ETHIK_MANIFEST.md) (Bias-Log, Abbruchkriterien)
- [ ] Read [CLAIMS_EVIDENCE_MATRIX.md](../../docs/CLAIMS_EVIDENCE_MATRIX.md) (existing claims)
- [ ] Check [LITERATUR_INDEX.md](../../07_daten_analysen/LITERATUR_INDEX.md) (existing sources)
- [ ] Pre-register hypothesis (OSF, AsPredicted, or issue comment)

**During Research:**
- [ ] Document biases (update ETHIK_MANIFEST.md if needed)
- [ ] Collect data ethically (Informed Consent, DSGVO, `storage/anonymize.py`)
- [ ] Version control (Git commits for analysis scripts)

**After Research:**
- [ ] Add BibTeX entries to `07_daten_analysen/5d-relevant-sources.bib`
- [ ] Update `docs/CLAIMS_EVIDENCE_MATRIX.md` (new claim or update evidenz level)
- [ ] Add tests (e.g., `tests/test_neuro_xxx.py`)
- [ ] Update dashboard (if applicable)
- [ ] Write summary in issue comment (results, limitations, next steps)
